name: Phú Yên
headline: Golden hour on the coast.
subheadline: Blue sky, stone cliffs, winding roads.
introduction: Phú Yên feels open: long coastal roads, low-key towns, clean horizons, and golden light that makes the landscape look wider than it is.
shortDescription: Stone cliffs, empty roads, blue sky, fishing villages, and one of central Vietnam's quieter coastal moods.
description: Golden hour on Gành Đá Đĩa, winding roads along the coast, and the bluest sky.
longDescription: The best version of Phú Yên is a road day with space between stops. The coast is the main character, but the quiet transitions between places are where the photos breathe.
overview: A quieter coastal province for road-light, cliffs, seafood stops, and wide blue frames.
weatherNote: The dry months are easier for coastal photos. Midday sun can be harsh, so save key stops for softer light.
travelTips: Do fewer stops and give each coastal route time.
Carry water if riding between viewpoints.
Plan around light, not only map distance.
notFor: Travelers who want dense nightlife or a packed city base.
seoTitle: Phú Yên Photo Notes | Coastal Roads and Golden Hour
seoDescription: A short editorial photo note from Phú Yên: coastal roads, stone cliffs, blue skies, seafood stops, and golden-hour landscapes.
